project.name: Milldens
project.boundarySource: Mapped named-place location with a conservative editorial study buffer
project.researchNotes: Catalogue-addition settlement gate. Nearby attractions, heritage properties and nature reserves do not inflate the place score. Angus-wide full audit completed 2026-09-01: all six visitor categories, the four named commercial trail providers, current official/conventional routes, strict-boundary scoring and local HES/NRHE integrity were checked.
